notes: Compact two-column public pin: date,value (USD/bbl), LF, UTF-8 without BOM, 9,137 non-missing observations. The raw FRED CSV (170,618 B; 10,310 weekday rows) is NOT committed, and its 1,173 holiday rows with '.' are excluded rather than filled. Values are copied as published; no monthly aggregation and no ALFRED vintage/revision archive is included, so this is a latest-published snapshot, not PIT. The pin is byte-identical to data/public/eia_brent_daily.csv (9,137 dates, 0 differences, max abs diff 0.0); FRED republishes the EIA RBRTE series, so this is a cross-check of the same measurement, not an independent source. It is a SPOT price, not an ICE/NYMEX futures settlement, and contains no curve/volumes/open interest. FRED terms: personal non-commercial with attribution; series label 'Public Domain: Citation Requested'; attribution to FRED and the U.S. EIA required. See docs/251.
